extracted.name: Easy Low-Carb Keto Broccoli Cheddar Soup
extracted.description: This easy, low-carb, keto-friendly broccoli cheddar soup is so tasty and ideal for those winter nights that we all need some comfort food!
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook garlic until tender, about 2 minutes. Add vegetable broth, heavy cream, and broccoli. Bring to a boil; simmer until broccoli is tender, about 15 minutes.
Add Cheddar cheese gradually, stirring constantly, until completely melted. Stir in bacon pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
